title: CDIF Access profile
description: Marked by an ODRL policy: odrl:hasPolicy on a schema:distribution item, or a schema:conditionsOfAccess item on the dataset that is itself described in the record as an odrl:Offer. The schema also accepts a bare {@id} in schema:conditionsOfAccess that points at a policy published elsewhere; that cannot be told from a reference to any other terms page, so it is NOT counted and such a record is not detected. The address is marked OPEN (not minted) in schema.yaml. DRAFT; not reviewed.
